reason: The code itself checks out on the 65SC12: every opcode and mode is real (BRA, STA abs,Y into the render_bss arrays, ADC abs,X on the HAZEL type tables, X=type indexes them with the same value Y did before), the y<2 re-entry into list_finish is right, list_type/list_x_lo/hi are read only by list_finish, and the hot path (y>=2, no clamp) recounts at 111 cycles against 120 before (list_recorded 40 + list_finish 80 with its taken BCC y2_ok), so 9 saved, with no new taken branches or page-sensitive reads. But it makes list_recorded 59 bytes longer (88 against 29), and bank 4 has no room for that in the oracle builds. Built in a scratch copy of HEAD with the candidate applied: the default and -Gameplay builds assemble, but DEFINES=SKY_HELI=0 fails with 'src/main.6502:151:5: error: bank 4 overruns the renderer's workspace by 50', and DEFINES=DEBUG_FULLREDRAW=1 (the passlock/worldrun oracle) fails with '... by 52'. HEAD builds both. The candidate breaks the DEBUG_FULLREDRAW and SKY_HELI=0 builds that the proof gate depends on.
